translations.note: These are astrological technical terms. "Intuentes" refers to aspects, the angles at which signs or planets "behold" one another. "Commanding" and "obeying" signs are pairs equidistant from the equinoctial axis. Antiscia are points symmetrical about the solstitial axis, and were held to be friendly. The construction is compressed.
